mentions.name: Hot Dev
mentions.description: A backend workflow platform. It features Hot, a functional expression-based language with types and built-in parallel constructs for integrations. Workflows are driven by event handlers (e.g. on "user:created") and scheduled events (e.g. "every hour"), any Hot function can be turned into an MCP Tool, and a real-time API exposes running tasks with workflow Streams subscribable via SSE updates. Observability includes a system-level dashboard, call-level tracing, and alerts to email, Slack, PagerDuty, or webhooks. Projects are developed locally and pushed to production with `hot deploy`, and an upcoming Hot Box feature will run any OCI container as a Hot function.
